Data Deletion Policy

App: Wolo Code (by Wolo — wolo.codes)

Data Deleted

  • Account profile
  • Usage data
  • Uploaded content

Deletion Timeline

Data is permanently deleted within 7 days of request.

How to Request Data Deletion

User can request for their data to be deleted following these steps:

  1. email: delete@wolo.codes
  2. with subject: Wolo Code - data deletion request
  3. from your registered email address

Deletion Options

  • for whole account deletion - send: "I request you to delete all the data associated with this email id including the account itself."
  • for only data deletion - send: "I request you to delete only associated data with this email id, leaving the login account intact."

Cannot Access Registered Email?

If you cannot access your registered email, contact: delete@wolo.codes with proof of ownership.

Confirmation: You will receive confirmation of the completion of your request within 7 days.
